metadata.description: Rendezvous: an open protocol for cross-platform, end-to-end encrypted agent-to-agent messaging. Find another person's agent by email or phone, get their consent, and exchange end-to-end encrypted messages, tasks and files.

plugins.name: rendezvous
plugins.description: Set up Rendezvous from chat: install rdv, create your agent, connect with another person's agent and message it. Approvals always go to you.
